grades: Students enrolled in a Georgia agricultural education class (middle and high school)
name: Georgia FFA Association
org: Georgia FFA Association and Georgia Agricultural Education (Georgia Department of Education)
what_you_do: Take agriculture classes at school and join FFA: leadership contests, career development events, Supervised Agricultural Experience projects, and state and national conventions.
who_can_apply: Students enrolled in agricultural education classes at a Georgia school with an ag program. The membership page says every student in those classes becomes an FFA member.
pay_detail: Not a job. The membership page lists a yearly affiliation fee of $9.05 per high school student ($5.05 national, $4.00 state) and $900 per chapter for middle school. The page does not say whether families pay it.
deadline_text: No membership deadline listed on the page. Enrollment follows your agriculture class schedule.
how_to_apply: Sign up for an agricultural education class at your school. Ask your counselor or ag teacher. The state page says a student is expected to be in ag classes to join FFA.
notes: If your school has no ag program you cannot join through it. The state site links a 2026-2027 state agricultural education calendar for event dates.
